role: Central type export hub for sensory, drive, IPC, provenance, decision-making, communication, confidence, metrics, scene, memory, and LLM subsystems.
detail: Re-exports type definitions and constants from 12 specialized type modules. Key subsystems: sensory-frame (VideoDetection, FaceDetection, SensoryFrame, EMBEDDING_DIM), drive.types (DriveName, DRIVE_RANGE, CORE_DRIVES, computeTotalPressure, PressureVector), ipc.types (DriveIPCMessage variants for Drive Engine isolation), provenance.types (OkgFactTier, resolveBaseConfidence, PROVENANCE_BASE_CONFIDENCE), decision-making.types (Episode, EpisodeInput, CognitiveContext, ConsolidationResult), communication.types (CycleResponse, KnowledgeGrounding), confidence.types (CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLDS, DEFAULT_DECAY_RATES, computeConfidence, applyGuardianWeight, qualifiesForGraduation/Demotion with ACTRParams), metrics.types (full re-export), scene.types (SceneEventType, TrackedObjectDTO, SceneSnapshot), working-memory.types (WorkingMemoryItem, WorkingMemorySnapshot), and llm.types (LlmTier, LlmRequest, LlmResponse, LlmContext, Type2CostEstimate, ILlmService, EpisodeSummary, WkgContextEntry, PersonModelSummary).
gotchas: Barrel file only — all implementation and specifics deferred to child modules; no local logic or side effects.
